verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an explicit release lifecycle: semantic versioning on a single v1.x line, backward-compatible releases with no breaking changes, 24-month major-version support, 12 months' notice before any end of life, and a dated changelog. The OpenAPI spec is versioned with each release in the official repo, so the policy covers the API. missing for 10: per-endpoint deprecation markers or notices in the API itself, independent or hands-on corroboration that the no-breaking-changes policy holds in practice, and a guarantee the hosted spec matches the release (the deployed copy can trail the source spec).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Windmill follows semantic versioning on one `v1.x` line. Every release is backward compatible and contains no breaking changes
12 months of advance notice before any end of life
The source-of-truth spec lives in the official windmill-labs/windmill repository (backend/windmill-api/openapi.yaml), versioned with each release.
